summary.text:
We need produce JSON only, architecture plan concise <=2000 words. Need include keys: state_machine list states/transitions, timer_plan, priorities, initial_values, scan_execution_order explicit 4-stage scan order, formal_assertions optional list with id/formula. Need base on spec. Need likely no timers, but timer_plan should state none required / empty list maybe with notes. Need state machine states: IDLE, EXTEND, CLAMP, RELEASE, RETRACT, DONE. Transitions one per scan. Stop/Reset priority to IDLE from any. Normal transitions: IDLE->EXTEND if Start & RetractDone. EXTEND->CLAMP if ExtendDone. CLAMP->RELEASE if ClampDone. RELEASE->RETRACT if ReleaseDone. RETRACT->DONE if RetractDone. DONE holds until Stop/Reset. Also holds in states if feedback not met. Need outputs match post-transition phase. Important: outputs post-transition. E.g if state q=IDLE and Start&RetractDone then transition to EXTEND, output Extend true. If q=EXTEND and ExtendDone transition to CLAMP, output Clamp true and Extend false. Thus outputs are based on next state after transition. Busy in active states 1..4 (EXTEND, CLAMP, RELEASE, RETRACT), Done in DONE. Stop/Reset outputs all false. At most one transition per scan. Edge sampling stage first. Safety/reset priority & state transitions next. Timers unconditional top-level outside CASE/IF stage 3 (none). Unified output assignments stage 4. Initial values include state IDLE and outputs false. Formal assertions: can include from LTL. Need over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names. We can list A1.. maybe mapping to P1/P2/P3... Perhaps include formulas with G etc. Need be accurate. Since optional, include some key assertions. Need JSON complete. Must not include markdown. Ensure valid JSON (double quotes). Keep concise but sufficient.

Need think of timer_plan: no timers, PT durations N/A, reset conditions N/A. Could be {"timers": [], "notes": "No timeout... handshake stall intended"}.

State machine structure: maybe list of states with name, outputs, transitions. Need include transitions list. Since requirement "list of states and transitions" maybe two keys? state_machine: {"states":[...], "transitions":[...]}. Need within key. Or state_machine: { "states": [...], "transitions": [...] }.

Need include scan_execution_order as explicit four-stage list. Maybe objects with stage/name/actions.

Need priorities: safety and operational priorities. Could be object with safety list, operational list.

Need formal_assertions: list of objects id/formula. Use port names. Need use qIdle? The assertion formulas may reference state variables? Spec says over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names. So avoid qIdle? Hmm "temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names" means formulas should use input/output names, not internal state qIdle. We can formulate output-only assertions mostly. Need perhaps include P1, P2, P10. Maybe include state-dependent assertions using outputs? For P3, qIdle is internal not port. Could express with output? qIdle implies all commands off and !Done? But qIdle might be indistinguishable from stop? Hmm formal assertions optional. Could include only output based ones:
A1: G(Extend + Clamp + Release + Retract <= 1) but LTL over BOOL maybe use int? Simpler: G(!(Extend & Clamp) & !(Extend & Release) & !(Extend & Retract) & !(Clamp & Release) & !(Clamp & Retract) & !(Release & Retract)).
A2: G((Stop | Reset) -> (!Busy & !Done & !Extend & !Clamp & !Release & !Retract)).
A3: G((Busy <-> (Extend | Clamp | Release | Retract)) & !(Busy & Done)).
A4: G((Done -> !Busy & !Extend & !Clamp & !Release & !Retract)) maybe.
A5: G(!(Extend & Done) etc maybe encompassed.
Could include initial? initial instance maybe not G. But formal assertions over ports. Use A1-A3.

Need be careful with "Busy holds in active steps 1..4" and P10 says Busy iff active outputs. Done holds in DONE. P2 says Stop/Reset -> all false. So outputs based on post-transition phase. For state DONE: Done true and all commands false, Busy false. For IDLE: all false. For EXTEND: Extend true, Busy true. For CLAMP: Clamp true, Busy true. For RELEASE: Release true, Busy true. For RETRACT: Retract true, Busy true. At transition from EXTEND to CLAMP in same scan, output Clamp true not Extend. The output assignments after transition. This is important in state_machine notes. For Stop/Reset priority, state becomes IDLE and outputs false even if transition condition also true. At most one transition per scan: implement as IF Stop OR Reset THEN state := IDLE ELSIF CASE state... one transition. Need mention transitions in terms of q[k] pre-state and output O[k] post-transition. Also "DONE holds until Stop/Reset" no auto restart. Start in DONE ignored until stop/reset then start? Note if Stop/Reset present, state idle; then next scan maybe Start. Good.

Potential edge cases: If Stop/Reset and Start, priority abort. If Stop/Reset in IDLE, no transition? It sets state IDLE and outputs off. That's effectively reset. At most one transition? Stop/Reset overrides. Fine.

Need timer_plan: no timers. Stage 3 "unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF". Even though none, state "No timer FBs; stage 3 is no-op." Maybe include "timer_fb_calls": [] and "PT": "N/A".

Need initial_values: state, commands, outputs. Maybe include Start etc? Initial values for variables likely internal state and outputs. Include all_commands false. Maybe include q state string. Need not include inputs. But could include "inputs_sampled_at_scan0": "not initialized; sampled from process." Keep to required.

Need "scan_execution_order": explicit 4-stage. Provide array of 4 objects with stage, name, implementation. Stage 1 edge sampling: latch inputs into scan-local values once. Since all level-sensitive no edges needed? But requirement says edge sampling. In this context: sample all inputs once at start; compute edge flags only if needed (none used). We can state no edge-dependent transitions; retain current values for one scan. Stage 2 safety/reset priority & state transitions: IF Stop OR Reset -> IDLE; ELSE one transition using sampled inputs and pre-state. Stage 3 unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: none; no-op. Stage 4 unified output assignments: assign outputs from updated state. Need ensure timer FB calls stage 3 occurs before output, no effect. Good.

Need maybe include "state_machine" with "notes": "q[k] pre-state, q[k+1] post, O[k] based on q[k+1] unless abort." Use "one_transition_per_scan": true.

Need formal assertions formula syntax. "G" and "F"? Use LTL. Ensure valid JSON escaping? Use parentheses and !, &, |, ->, <->. The formula strings can have these. Use "G((Stop | Reset) -> (!Busy & !Done & !Extend & !Clamp & !Release & !Retract))". Need not use int. A1 with pairwise mutual exclusion. Could also use "G(!(Extend & Clamp) & ...)" inside G. Use formula: "G(!(Extend & Clamp) & !(Extend & Release) & !(Extend & Retract) & !(Clamp & Release) & !(Clamp & Retract) & !(Release & Retract))". Good. A2 as P2. A3: "G((Busy <-> (Extend | Clamp | Release | Retract)) & !(Busy & Done))". A4 maybe "G((Done -> (!Extend & !Clamp & !Release & !Retract & !Busy)) & (!Done | (Done & !Busy)))" not needed. Maybe include initial? "init" not G. They asked optional list of temporal/invariant assertions. Include A1-A4. Maybe include A4 for Done exclusivity: already A3. Could include A4 "G((Extend | Clamp | Release | Retract) -> Busy)" redundant. Keep 3.

Need ensure no exhaustive traces. Fine.

Need word count <=2000. JSON concise. Need no markdown. Final only JSON. Let's craft.

Potential issue: formal_assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names. Use exact names: Start, Stop, Reset, ExtendDone, ClampDone, ReleaseDone, RetractDone, Extend, Clamp, Release, Retract, Busy, Done. Good.

Need maybe include "timer_plan" as object not list. Requirement says "timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions". Could be {"timers": [], "pt_durations": "none", "reset_conditions": "none", "notes": ...}. Good.

Need state_machine transitions all conditions. Include "abort" transition from any state to IDLE. Maybe represent as separate transition object from "*" to IDLE with priority 0. And normal transitions priority 1+ with guard. Need "one per scan" note. Use "from": "ANY". Need include hold transitions? State machine list of states and transitions. Holds are implicit no transition causing output hold? But outputs depend on state. In active states, output stays active. In DONE, holds. In IDLE, holds if no start. Could include hold transitions as self transitions? But at most one transition per scan. If we include self transitions, then "transition" semantics ambiguous. Better list transition only when state changes, and note "hold is no transition; outputs still recomputed from retained state." But requirement "list of states and transitions" not necessarily every hold. Include state definitions with outputs, and transitions. For DONE "no normal transition; holds". For active states "if feedback not true, no transition; hold". Good.

Need output semantics: "post-transition phase." In transitions, output for next state. For abort, IDLE outputs off. For IDLE->EXTEND, output Extend. For EXTEND->CLAMP output Clamp. For no transition, output remains from current state? Since output assignments based on updated state (which equals current if no transition), yes. For DONE, Done. Good. But note P3 expects G((normal & qIdle & Start & RetractDone) -> Extend). At scan where qIdle and condition, transition to EXTEND, outputs Extend true. Good.
P4 qExtend & ExtendDone -> Clamp. If transition to CLAMP, outputs Clamp true. Good.
P9 qExtend & !ExtendDone -> Extend. No transition, outputs from EXTEND: Extend true. Good.
P11 qClamp & !ClampDone -> Clamp, etc. Good.

Need initial case: at scan 0 qIdle. If Start false, all off. If Start & RetractDone true, transition to EXTEND and output Extend true in scan0. That matches P3. Good.

Need timer plan no timeout; absent handshake stalls. Stage 3 no-op. Good.

Need "priorities": safety: stop/reset overrides, one transition, output mutual exclusion, busy/done exclusivity. Operational: sample inputs once; one transition per scan; DONE holds; normal start requires home; handshake level-sensitive. Good.

Need "initial_values": maybe include "state" and "outputs". Include "internal": {"state": "IDLE", "all_commands": false}. Also maybe "outputs": {...}. Good.

Need final JSON. Ensure all quotes. Let's produce.
